question: As of November 2026, who is the CEO of Target Corporation?
answer: Michael Fiddelke is the CEO of Target Corporation as of November 2026 [1][4]. He succeeded Brian Cornell on February 1, 2026, and Cornell moved to executive chairman of the board [4]. Target's November 12, 2026 press release on the appointment of Sally Grimes to its board also quotes Fiddelke as Target CEO [1].
